scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

The imported polygon appears only from 1492 to 1500 and spans a broad part of the eastern Guianas. It remains approximate and unverified; later fieldwork and contemporary projects are not projected back into that snapshot.
Aparai and Wayana maintain distinct identities despite intermarriage and joint projects. Their separate runtime records are not automatically merged; each joint example identifies both peoples.

The pottery book was read from the ISA archive mirror after the publisher’s download returned 403. The 2017 imprint and May 2018 publication announcement are distinguished. Portuguese explanatory passages were read; no independent translation of Indigenous-language passages is claimed.

Pottery examples come from documented living practices, not excavated deposits or proof of a particular ancient production date. The graphic-art source is a museum catalogue description, not the complete book.

Barbosa’s published ethnographic scene is presented as an account, not as independently verified biographical events for its named characters. No exact date or present price is assigned to a transaction.

Descriptions of the 2024 house differ slightly on construction duration; no exact number of months is used. Public architectural functions are summarized without instructions for restricted ceremonies.

Funai and Iepé accounts differ on expedition participant counts and departure dates. The card uses the common 2024 date and documented purposes, not a synthesized exact itinerary or an assertion that all non-Aparai Indigenous presence had disappeared from the lower river.
The crop-health source was read as a project report. No video viewing, treatment efficacy assessment or universal claim about all household farming practices is made.
The fund’s initial arrangements are attributed to its own account. Long-term goals are not represented as already delivered infrastructure or independently audited financial results.
No ancient founding, state dissolution or unverified territorial successor is invented. Independent historical review, geometry assessment and depth certification remain pending.
